facts.en: Completed an industrial administration diploma at Fictional Flintgarden Institute in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构燧石花园学院完成工业行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Completed internal document-control orientation in 2021-03; it was not auditor certification.
facts.zh: 2021-03 完成内部文档控制入门培训；并非审核员认证。

facts.en: Packing records clerk at Fictional Ceramic Finch, 2018-10 to 2021-06.
facts.zh: 2018-10 至 2021-06 在虚构陶瓷雀机构任包装记录文员。

facts.en: Quality documentation assistant at Fictional Ceramic Finch, 2021-07 to 2024-09.
facts.zh: 2021-07 至 2024-09 在虚构陶瓷雀机构任质量文档助理。

facts.en: Quality records coordinator at Fictional Ceramic Finch, 2024-10 to 2026-09; these are successive roles at one fictional employer.
facts.zh: 2024-10 至 2026-09 在虚构陶瓷雀机构任质量记录协调员；这些是在同一虚构雇主的连续岗位。

facts.en: As a packing clerk, copied batch identifiers from approved packing sheets without judging product quality.
facts.zh: 任包装文员时从批准的包装表抄录批次标识，不判断产品质量。

facts.en: In the current role, indexes signed inspection forms and checks revision numbers against the document register.
facts.zh: 在现岗位索引已签字检验表，并依据文档登记表检查版本号。

facts.en: Requests missing signatures from authorized inspectors; does not sign on their behalf.
facts.zh: 向获授权检验员索取缺失签名；不代其签字。

facts.en: Co-designed a form-revision reminder sheet with a quality engineer during 2025-02 to 2025-03.
facts.zh: 2025-02 至 2025-03 与质量工程师共同设计表单版本提醒表。

facts.en: Personally built revision lookup formulas and recorded obsolete form identifiers; the engineer approved the master register.
facts.zh: 个人制作版本查找公式并记录过时表单标识；主登记表由工程师批准。

facts.en: The 2025-05 review found current revisions in 46 of 50 sampled forms, versus 38 of 45 in 2025-01; the samples were different.
facts.zh: 2025-05 审核发现，抽样 50 份表单中有 46 份为当前版本；2025-01 抽样 45 份中为 38 份；样本不同。

facts.en: Rolled the approved reminder sheet out to the records desk in 2025-04, not to production equipment.
facts.zh: 2025-04 将获批提醒表应用至记录工作台，而非生产设备。

facts.en: Drafted an image-based defect catalogue in 2026-06; photographs had not been technically reviewed by 2026-09.
facts.zh: 2026-06 起草基于图像的缺陷目录；截至 2026-09 照片尚未经过技术审核。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet lookups, file naming conventions, and read-only archival folders.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格查找、文件命名规则及只读归档文件夹。

facts.en: Prepares requested document bundles for internal reviews without acting as the auditor.
facts.zh: 为内部审核准备所需文档包，不担任审核员。

facts.en: In the document-control orientation, practiced identifying obsolete fictional forms; this was training, not an audit.
facts.zh: 在文档控制入门培训中练习识别过时虚构表单；此为培训，并非审核。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Model Railway Club on 2024-11 weekends alongside paid employment.
facts.zh: 2024-11 周末在虚构模型铁路社做志愿者，与有薪工作同期。

facts.en: Labeled storage boxes for the club; the activity did not involve industrial quality checks.
facts.zh: 为社团标记储物箱；该活动不涉及工业质量检查。

facts.en: Maintained a personal knitting pattern notebook with 17 trial swatches in 2025.
facts.zh: 2025 年维护个人编织花样笔记，含 17 块试织样片。

facts.en: Enjoys knitting and listening to radio plays.
facts.zh: 爱好编织及收听广播剧。

facts.en: A reference draft calls the candidate quality auditor, while the signed role history states records coordinator.
facts.zh: 一份推荐草稿称候选人为质量审核员，而签字岗位历史为记录协调员。

facts.en: No batch-release authority or external quality auditor qualification is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录批次放行权限或外部质量审核员资格。
